CFML Language Reference: Functions

ToString

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Converts a simple value or a binary object to a string. Numbers, booleans and dates come back in the same form in which they would be output.

Category

String functions

Syntax

ToString(value)

Parameters

value
A string, number, boolean, date/time value or binary object.

Returns

The value as a string.

Usage

The main use is turning a binary object (from ToBinary or CFFILE ACTION="ReadBinary") back into text. Dates convert to an ODBC timestamp such as {ts '1999-12-31 23:59:59'}.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Bin = ToBinary(ToBase64("Hello from the binary side"))>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TD>ToString(binary)</TD><TD>#ToString(Bin)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ToString(42 * 2)</TD><TD>#ToString(42 * 2)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ToString(1 LT 2)</TD><TD>#ToString(1 LT 2)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ToString(CreateDateTime(1999,12,31,23,59,59))</TD><TD>#ToString(CreateDateTime(1999,12,31,23,59,59))#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ToBinary, ToBase64, IsBinary, IsSimpleValue
